description: The number of people in each age group on the dementia register.
The number of patients who have received an assessment for dementia and declined a GP memory assessment since the start of the reporting year (April).
The number of patients who have received an assessment for dementia and declined a GP memory clinic referral since the start of the reporting year (April).
The number of patients who have received an assessment since the start of the reporting year (April).
The number of patients who have received an assessment for dementia and received a GP memory assessment since the start of the reporting year (April).
The number of patients who have received an assessment for dementia and received a GP memory clinic referral since the start of the reporting year (April).
The number of patients with a diagnosis of dementia who received care plan or care plan review in the preceding 12 months.
The number of patients with a diagnosis of dementia who declined a care plan or care plan review in the preceding 12 months.
The number of patients with a recorded diagnosis of dementia, who had received a dementia care plan or care plan review and a medication review since the start of the reporting year (April).
The number of patients who were recorded as having dementia and one or more of the following comorbidities: diabetes, stroke, hypertension and coronary heart disease.

The number of patients with a recorded dementia diagnosis, who had a diagnosis of delirium on or after their earliest dementia diagnosis where the diagnosis of delirium was recorded in the last 12 months.
The estimated number of people living with dementia based on the Dementia 65+ estimated diagnosis rate.
The number of people currently diagnosed with dementia.
The number of people currently diagnosed with dementia under the age of 65.
The number of people currently diagnosed with dementia over the age of 65.
The number of patients diagnosed with each subtype of dementia.
The estimated diagnosis rate for patients over 65.
The lower limit of the diagnosis rate based on a 95% confidence interval.
The upper limit of the diagnosis rate based on a 95% confidence interval.
The number of patients diagnosed with dementia, split by ethnic group.
Number of patients newly diagnosed with dementia.
Number of patients with a diagnosis of dementia who are also on the palliative care register.
Total number of patients under 65. This number is calculated by summing practice list size.
Total number of patients over 65. This number is calculated by summing practice list size.
Total number of patients.
Number of patients with a dementia diagnosis split by residential type.
Number of patients with a dementia diagnosis split by sex.
The number of patients who were recorded as having dementia before the age of 65.
